name: reference-and-wildcards
source:
#prisma 4.0
def "a" { reference "missing.prism" "/parts/*" } def "b" {} def "m1" {} def "m2" {} connect </*.x> = </m2.out> connect </a.x> = </m1.out>

name: overlay-tombstones
source:
#prisma 4.0
def group "world" { def object "sphere" { float radius = 2 float radius.timeSamples = { 0: 2, 24: 5 } } over material "mat" { float gain = 0.5 string note = "tweaked" unset oldParam unset string oldNote } } connect </world/sphere.albedo> = </world/mat.out> delete "/world/junk" disconnect "/world/sphere.radius"
